newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan textiles rise on product price increases.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan textiles rise on product price increases.

text.p: Taiwan textile shares rose in early Monday trade as rising demand pushed up ployester fibre product prices, brokers said.

After 45 minutes, textiles rose 1.58 percent while the overall index was up 0.96 percent. Hualon rose 50 cents or 2.04 percent to T$25 and Shinkong Synthetic Fibre surged 70 cents or 3.12 percent to T$23.20.

"Local manufacturers have raised their export prices in polyester drawn texturized yarn, polyester filament and staple, and are expected to increase their domestic sales prices soon," said Tank Hung of Yuanta Securities.
"This indicates the textile industry has bottomed out and (is heading for) a gradaul recovery," he said.
